prompt: I'm thinking about building something in the meal planning space but honestly I have no idea if there's anything actually there or if it's a graveyard. Can you dig into it properly and give me a writeup I can send my cofounder? She'll want to see the numbers, not vibes.

assertions.text: The deliverable is a markdown file, not just chat output
Findings cite real monthly search volumes for named keywords
Findings cite real click prices (CPC or top-of-page bid)
The report states what the research actually cost
At least one finding is about what searchers are trying to do, not just how many there are
No single observation is restated more than twice as separate findings
The report says what it does NOT know, or what it checked and could not confirm
The report reaches a clear verdict on whether there is a market here, rather than only listing data
